answer: Locking staking collateral into a zero-knowledge verifiable delay forces each attestation to burn a non-refundable fee, so the adversary's opportunity cost compounds as the delta of cumulative slashing penalties outpaces any reward. The meadow of fees creates a convex marginal cost curve that guarantees negative expected attack utility for every additional Sybil identity. Thus the protocol attains a robust Nash equilibrium where rational agents abandon duplication because the falcon of marginal loss dominates potential gain.
